name: test_uiqml_probe
description: THROWAWAY PROBE: the smallest possible `type: ui_qml` + `interface: universal` module. Forwards the eight methods behind the nine hostile-argument cases to test_fullapi_cpp so we can settle, by building and running, WHICH dispatch a universal ui_qml module actually gets (api-style=qt provider dispatch vs --backend cdylib) and whether the argument-coercion defect survives the migration.
